entries.name: CompTIA Linux Network Professional (CLNP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for Linux and network administration.

entries.name: CompTIA Mobile App Security+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering how to build and test mobile apps securely.

entries.name: CompTIA Mobility+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the management and support of mobile devices and the systems that manage them.

entries.name: CompTIA Network+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering how to configure, manage, secure and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.

entries.name: CompTIA Network Infrastructure Professional (CNIP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for network infrastructure.

entries.name: CompTIA Network Security Professional (CNSP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for network security.

entries.name: CompTIA Network Vulnerability Assessment Professional (CNVP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for network vulnerability assessment.

entries.name: CompTIA PenTest+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering penetration testing, vulnerability assessment and vulnerability management.

entries.name: CompTIA Printing and Document Imaging (PDI+)
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for technicians who work with printing and document imaging equipment.

entries.name: CompTIA RFID+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology and its deployment.

entries.name: CompTIA Secure Cloud Professional (CSCP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for secure cloud work.

entries.name: CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Specialist (CSIS)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for secure IT infrastructure.

entries.name: CompTIA Security+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering core cybersecurity skills such as threats, network security, cryptography and risk management.

entries.name: CompTIA Security Analytics Expert (CSAE)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for security analytics at expert level.

entries.name: CompTIA Security Analytics Professional (CSAP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for security analytics at professional level.

entries.name: CompTIA Security Infrastructure Expert (CSIE)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for security infrastructure at expert level.

entries.name: CompTIA Storage+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the fundamentals of data storage technology.
variants: CompTIA Storage+ Powered By SNIA CE

entries.name: CompTIA Systems Support Specialist (CSSS)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for systems support.

entries.name: Coronal polishing certificate
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a dental assistant has been trained in coronal polishing, which some US states require before they may do it.

entries.name: Counter Terrorist Check (CTC) clearance
entries.definition: A UK government security clearance level, below Security Check (SC), for roles with unescorted access to sensitive sites or close contact with people at risk from terrorism.

entries.name: Certified Professional Coder
entries.definition: A coding credential; CPC also names other credentials.

entries.name: Certified Professional Collector
entries.definition: A collection credential; distinct from the coding credential.

entries.name: CPR for the Professional Rescuer
entries.definition: A cardiopulmonary resuscitation certification, from American Red Cross courses, for people who respond to emergencies as part of their job, such as lifeguards and first responders.

entries.name: Crestron Certified Programmer
entries.definition: A certification from Crestron showing that a person can program Crestron control systems.

entries.name: Cytogenetic Technologist, CG(ASCP)
entries.definition: A certification from the ASCP Board of Certification for laboratory technologists who analyse chromosomes in cytogenetics laboratories.

entries.name: Dermatology Certified Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A certification for nurse practitioners who specialise in dermatology, awarded by the Dermatology Nurse Practitioner Certification Board.

entries.name: Dermatology Nurse Certified
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who work in dermatology, awarded by the Dermatology Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Developed Vetting
entries.definition: The highest level of UK government security clearance, for roles with frequent and uncontrolled access to top secret assets.

entries.name: Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology
entries.definition: A diploma, awarded by technical boards and polytechnic institutions in India, covering hotel operations, food production and catering.

entries.name: Divemaster
entries.definition: A professional scuba-diving rating for people who lead and supervise certified divers, awarded by diving training agencies such as PADI, SSI and NAUI.

entries.name: Doctor of Dental Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in dentistry, awarded by dental schools in the United States and elsewhere.

entries.name: Doctor of Dental Surgery
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in dentistry, awarded by dental schools in the United States and elsewhere.

entries.name: Doctor of Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in medicine that qualifies graduates to go on to practise as physicians.

entries.name: Doctor of Nursing Practice
entries.definition: A practice-focused doctoral degree in nursing for advanced clinical practice, leadership and nursing care improvement.

entries.name: Doctor of Pharmacy
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in pharmacy that qualifies graduates to go on to practise as pharmacists.

entries.name: Doctor of Physical Therapy
entries.definition: A doctoral degree that qualifies graduates to practise as physical therapists in the United States.

entries.name: Doctor of Public Health
entries.definition: A doctoral degree in public health focused on professional practice and leadership.

entries.name: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in veterinary medicine, awarded as DVM by most schools and as VMD by the University of Pennsylvania.

entries.name: Doubles/triples endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement that permits towing two or three trailers.

entries.name: Drone pilot certificate
entries.definition: A certificate that allows a person to fly small unmanned aircraft commercially; in the United States, the FAA Remote Pilot Certificate under Part 107.
